metadata.question: In areas across the northeastern Pacific Ocean, were sea surface temperatures cooler in August 2019 than the average for the same month from 1985-2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need sea surface temperature data for the northeastern Pacific Ocean. MODIS Aqua has SST data (band 'sst') from 2002 onward, but the question asks for 1985-2012 average vs 2019. Need a longer time series - could use NOAA OISST which goes back to 1981, or ERA5 reanalysis. However, in GEE, the most accessible long-term SST data is from the NOAA OISST v2.1 dataset. 2. Location: Northeastern Pacific Ocean - need to define a polygon covering this region. Typical definition would be roughly 30°N-60°N, 180°W-120°W. 3. Time periods: - Baseline: August months from 1985-2012 (28 years) - Comparison: August 2019 4. Processing: Calculate mean SST for each August in baseline period, then compare 2019 to that average. 5. Data availability check: NOAA OISST should have data for this period. Let me use: - Dataset: NOAA OISST v2.1 (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1')) - Band: 'sst' (sea surface temperature in °C) - Region: Polygon covering northeastern Pacific - Time: August months only Need to handle: - Check if collections have data - Calculate baseline average (1985-2012 August) - Compare with 2019 August - Validate results ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const nePacific = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-180, 30], [-120, 30], [-120, 60], [-180, 60], [-180, 30]] ]); // 2. Data Acquisition const sstCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1').select('sst'); // Baseline: August months 1985-2012 const baselineFilter = ee.Filter.and( ee.Filter.calendarRange(1985, 2012, 'year'), ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month') ); const baselineCol = sstCol.filter(baselineFilter); // Comparison: August 2019 const aug2019Col = sstCol.filterDate('2019-08-01', '2019-09-01'); // Check data availability const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); const aug2019Size = aug2019Col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline images (1985-2012 Aug): ${baselineSize}`); console.log(`2019 August images: ${aug2019Size}`); if (baselineSize === 0 || aug2019Size === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate baseline climatology const baselineMean = baselineCol.mean(); // Get 2019 August mean const aug2019Mean = aug2019Col.mean(); // 4. Calculate regional means const baselineStats = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nePacific, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const aug2019Stats = aug2019Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nePacific, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const baselineSST = baselineStats.get('sst').getInfo(); const aug2019SST = aug2019Stats.get('sst').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels if (baselineSST === null || aug2019SST === null) { console.log("No valid SST values retrieved"); console.log("C2"); return; } // Validate temperature range (reasonable SST values) if (baselineSST < -2 || baselineSST > 35 || aug2019SST < -2 || aug2019SST > 35) { console.log(`Invalid SST values: baseline=${baselineSST}, 2019=${aug2019SST}`); console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Comparison and final answer console.log(`Baseline SST (1985-2012 Aug): ${baselineSST.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`2019 August SST: ${aug2019SST.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Difference: ${(aug2019SST - baselineSST).toFixed(2)}°C`); if (aug2019SST < baselineSST) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
